story: God sees the earth corrupt (SERIES.md episode 7; arc 2, Brothers and the walk with God)
people: No approved character lived in Genesis 6 (Adam, Eve and the serpent belong to Eden) and Noah is not in the character bible yet: the corruption is acted out by anonymous people seen only from behind or in silhouette; two establishing shots (2 s each); God only through the fading light of the storm.

narration.text: There is a verse where God's heart breaks.
It is about us. Ten generations after Eden, the earth is full of people, and full of noise.
And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
Not some thoughts. Every one. Only evil. Continually. And then comes a line most readers rush past.
And it repented the Lord that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
The text does not say God was angry first. It says He was grieved, at His heart.
The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
Violence in every camp, and on every road. And yet, in the middle of it, one small word.
But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord.
Notice the order. Grief comes before judgment. The flood is not the story of a cold God, but of a wounded heart.
The full story is in the long video. Part eight tomorrow: Noah builds the ark.
